The task failed due to Excel formula errors (#NAME?) in the statistics section of the generated workbook.
While the file structure and lookup blocks passed, the 'test_derived_values_and_stats' suite failed with multiple AssertionError instances. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 returned '#NAME?' instead of the expected floating-point statistical values. This indicates that the formulas injected into the 'Task' worksheet use undefined names, unsupported functions, or incorrect syntax that openpyxl or the verifier cannot resolve.
